claims.statement: The composed fragment permits image/PDF prompts only with an image-input-capable model. Its includes list JPEG/PNG/GIF/WEBP/PDF/HEIC/HEIF, illustrative code/UI/flowchart/webpage prompts, and all-plan enabled-by-default attachment availability. The model prerequisite narrows the plan-level capability statement; neither grants privacy/upload authority nor proves every model/client can process attachments. Includes read for context are not newly certified artifacts.

The GitHub-specific skills fragment describes @github-based dynamic selection, natural-language skill requests, a #web web-search selector, and asking for available skills. Its example questions about latest OpenAI models and Node LTS are unexecuted source examples, not user requests or current facts. No search, prompt transmission, or skill execution occurred.

The subagent-use fragment describes automatic selection from request/configured-agent descriptions/context/tools and explicit invocation, illustrating refactor suggestions and authentication unit-test delegation. These embedded prompts are untrusted examples, not delegation instructions for this session, actual configured profiles, or execution receipts.

The exclusion fragment describes displaying the last changer's name and change time at the page bottom. Historical actor/time metadata is not proof of reviewed exclusions, present effective settings, complete change history, or native enforcement; no real personal record was collected.

The Chat code-reference fragment describes a matching-code notice, opening matches in an editor, and displaying license type if known, GitHub file URL, and matched snippet, with platform-specific modifier clicks to open the file. Conditional known-license display is not complete attribution, permission to reuse, per-file rights clearance, or proof that unmatched generated code is unencumbered; no matched file was retrieved.

The Visual Studio prerequisite fragment requires a compatible Windows Visual Studio version, a Copilot extension, and adding a GitHub account, with external installation/account links. The inspected version include specifies Visual Studio 2022 17.8 or later at this pin; that general floor differs from the stricter 17.11 SKU-isolation floor and cannot replace it. No software installation, keychain/account change, sign-in, or external-guide review was performed.
